chapter: Disintegration of Second World & Collapse of Bipolarity
questionText:
Which of the following countries was accepted as the successor state of
the Soviet Union?

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for The End of Bipolarity.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Disintegration of Second World & Collapse of Bipolarity (The End of Bipolarity):
Russia

Detailed Analysis:
Following the formal dissolution of the Soviet Union in December 1991, the Russian Federation was accepted by the international community as the sole successor state of the USSR. Russia inherited the Soviet permanent seat with veto power on the UN Security Council, accepted all Soviet international treaties and debt obligations, and took custody of Soviet nuclear weapons.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
